entries.claim: Fanatics is a US sports-commerce company (licensed merchandise) founded in 1995 by Michael Rubin.
Fanatics expanded into trading cards/collectibles via the Topps acquisition.
entries.source_ref: Public acquisition reporting (deal value reported, not audited)

entries.claim: Fanatics operates a US sportsbook (Fanatics Betting & Gaming).
entries.source_ref: Public reporting; state licence numbers NOT asserted

entries.claim: Fanatics runs live-commerce (Fanatics Live) and events businesses, plus Candy Digital for digital collectibles.
Fanatics maintains a unified customer identity/account across e-commerce, collectibles and betting.
Fanatics operates FanCash, a cross-vertical loyalty currency.
entries.source_ref: Public FanCash program terms; exact earn/expiry rules UNKNOWN

entries.claim: Fanatics is a private company reported at roughly a US$31B valuation (2022 round), with league/players-association equity involvement reported.
Fanatics has no published standalone audited financial statements (private company).
entries.source_ref: Absence of public filings; reported revenue figures are third-party estimates

entries.claim: The betting pillar is regulated per US state with geolocation/KYC requirements.
The Fanatics client delivery model and SSO/identity vendor integrations are not determinable without an artefact.
FanCash ledger internals (accrual, expiry, redemption limits) are not stated and require official program terms or network-trace capture.
entries.source_ref: Official FanCash program terms / REA network-trace; never to be fabricated

entries.claim: The cross-vertical value loop (unified identity + shared currency) is a synthesised model from public reporting, not observed code.
